source_snapshot.procedure:
【Before Test】
    1. Check that the SUT configuration (e.g., hardware, firmware, drivers, etc.) matches the specifications/recipe definition.
    2. Clear logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.).

    【During Test】
    1. Send command: ipmitool sdr elist
Check sensor reading change when temperature increase or decrease.
2. Send command: ipmitool sensor list
Check sensor threshold(upper/lower warning/critical) match with the spec
3. Set fan speed lower than the warning and critical threshold
Check SEL when sensor reach to threshold

    【After Test】
    1. Collect test results and photos, and save them to specific folders.
    2. Check if there are unexpected logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.) generate after test.
source_snapshot.criteria:
1. Speed should have a normal change behavior.
2. All setting should be correct and match with spec.(including sdr type)
3. SEL should have a correct log when sensor reach to each threshold.
4. System should have correct behavior, like shutdown or change fan speed, when reach to threshold.
5. All SPD_FAN1_F~SPD_FAN16_F should get pass result.

original_test_intent: After Project SPEC defines `_F`, exercise every applicable SPD_FAN1_F through SPD_FAN16_F speed channel across approved lower-warning and lower-critical transitions, prove its distinct tach/event identity relative to the companion `_R` range, verify protection response, and restore stable automatic cooling.
original_method: The source asks to lower fan speed beneath warning and critical thresholds while reading IPMI sensor data. The `_F` suffix is not defined, and a preceding `_R` sensor range means the review must not assume orientation, rotor role or independent control semantics.
manual_activity: An engineer defines `_F` without guessing, establishes its physical relationship to `_R`, verifies which controls are shared, approves a bounded thermal-safe sequence, validates independent feedback and stays present with emergency cooling authority.
required_inputs: Authoritative `_F` definition and its relationship to each same-index `_R` sensor
Fan1~16 `_F` physical module/rotor/zone/tach/SDR/control map, installed applicability and any aliases or shared endpoints
BMC/CPLD/fan-controller firmware, automatic policy, supported vendor interface and exact mapping from control request to observed `_F`/`_R` tach changes
per-`_F` RPM/PWM units, lower warning/critical limits, hysteresis, event data/severity, deassert and platform protection expectations
approved workload/ambient baseline, channel or group sequence, ramp/dwell/maximum exposure, whole-platform thermal abort and automatic-control recovery
independent tach/airflow where feasible, critical component temperatures, controller/audit/SEL retention and recovery ownership
safety_requirements: Do not interpret `_F`, select a rotor, lower cooling, change thresholds or send raw control bytes until the `_F`/`_R` topology and supported reversible interface are approved.
Detect whether an `_F` control is shared with `_R`, an entire fan module or zone before stimulus; do not count one physical response twice or assume independent controls.
Default to one qualified control group at a time, with continuous `_F` and `_R` tach, airflow/temperature, controller fault, fan redundancy, power and host/BMC monitoring.

Abort and restore automatic control on wrong-channel movement, stalled/unstable rotor, excessive pair mismatch, redundancy loss, thermal rise/overshoot, controller/BMC loss, host instability or shutdown.
Preserve the first target, counterpart, SEL, controller and thermal fault evidence; do not clear logs or auto-retry.
Verify both members of every affected `_F`/`_R` pair, peer fans, automatic policy and all critical temperatures recover and stabilize before the next checkpoint.
agent_execution_scope: After approval, baseline the complete `_F` matrix alongside same-index `_R` channels and record aliases, shared controls, normal pair ratios, thresholds, events and temperature state.

Execute only the approved bounded control for the selected physical rotor/module/zone while capturing synchronized requested duty/mode, `_F` and `_R` RPM, peer compensation, airflow/thermal, controller, SEL and host evidence.

Report an independent lower-warning, lower-critical, deassert and recovery result for each applicable `_F` sensor, including whether the corresponding `_R` channel changed as expected; an `_R` result cannot substitute for `_F`.
Do not invent suffix meaning, assume front/forward/failover, operate unapproved controls, alter thresholds, clear evidence, auto-retry or determine PASS/FAIL.
engineer_actions: Approve `_F` definition, `_F`/`_R` physical and control relationships, applicable channels, thresholds/events and acceptable pair behavior.
Approve and supervise the sequential or qualified group control, thermal envelope, abort, emergency cooling and restore plan.
Resolve any alias, pair mismatch, cooling or protection anomaly and issue per-`_F` plus overall DUT verdicts.

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: The SDR/sensor lists are baseline-only, expose a password and disable host verification, cannot distinguish control aliases, perform a low-speed transition, retrieve SEL or prove `_F`-specific recovery.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Use protected authenticated IPMI for SDR/SEL collection plus the approved vendor fan-control interface, with simultaneous `_F`/`_R` tach, independent airflow or tach and whole-platform thermal monitoring and a verified automatic-policy restore.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: The exact SPD_FAN1_F~SPD_FAN16_F range, required below-warning/critical action, high-level IPMI reads, script and 5/10-minute values remain; Project SPEC supplies suffix semantics and safe timing.

modernized_recommendation.status: PROJECT F/R FAN TOPOLOGY AND CONTROL PLAN REQUIRED
modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Establish the `_F`/`_R` pair matrix and control aliases, baseline closed-loop cooling, apply bounded approved reductions to each applicable `_F` path, correlate its thresholds and protection response with the counterpart channel, restore automatic policy and prove pair and thermal recovery.
modernized_recommendation.applicable_platform: Exact chassis, dual-rotor or other fan topology, installed population, fan zones, BMC/CPLD/controller firmware, cooling policy and workload.
modernized_recommendation.supported_version: Record fan FRU/rotor mapping, BMC/CPLD/controller/SDR, vendor tool, independent sensor and monitoring versions.
modernized_recommendation.official_reference: Vendor or Project fan-module topology, suffix naming, control alias, SDR threshold, redundancy, fail-safe and thermal-limit specification.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds authoritative suffix semantics, paired `_F`/`_R` attribution, shared-control detection, cross-channel response and verified pair recovery without changing the Master row.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Static presence, an `_R` transition, or a shared-zone response without attribution is partial evidence and cannot prove all applicable `_F` channels.
modernized_recommendation.required_inputs: F/R topology, control aliases, limit/event matrix, safe sequence and recovery.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: A nominal `_F` request may affect both rotors or a whole zone; an incorrect suffix assumption can reduce the wrong cooling path and invalidate both coverage and safety controls.

project_override_considerations: Project SPEC may document a vendor-specific meaning for `_F`, non-populated positions or zone-level shared controls, but must show how each source sensor is covered, identify aliasing and list any unexercised individual path. `_R` evidence is not automatically equivalent.
expected_evidence: Authoritative `_F` definition plus Fan1~16 `_F`/`_R` physical, rotor, zone, tach, SDR, control-alias and applicability matrix
BMC/CPLD/controller/SDR versions, automatic-policy baseline, normal pair relationship, thresholds, hysteresis, event and protection matrix
approved control-group order, requested setpoints/ramp/dwell, workload/ambient, independent monitoring and abort/restore plan
timestamped request/control mode, `_F` and `_R` RPM, peer compensation, airflow/critical temperatures, controller faults, SEL, power and host/BMC state
per-applicable-`_F` lower-warning/lower-critical assert/deassert timing with correct sensor/event identity
restored automatic control, recovered F/R pair ratios and peer fans, stabilized thermal state, preserved evidence and engineer verdicts

Row 790 remains independent by physical identity. Undefined `_F` semantics relative to `_R` are Project topology inputs, not an irreducible source contradiction.

comparison_to_prior_reviews.deepseek: Changes YES/no-risk to conditional attended execution and rejects static lists as proof of `_F` dynamic coverage.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.gpt_v2: Rejects its unverified candidate expansions of `_F` and changes permanent BLOCKED to REQUIRES PACKAGE / USER CONFIRMATION under ED-36 while retaining safety gates.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.invalid_checkpoint_1000: Independently strengthens the required `_F`/`_R` pair topology, shared-control alias detection, wrong-channel abort and per-pair recovery evidence.

review_improvement: Prevents an undefined suffix or shared controller from conflating `_F` with `_R`, while retaining all sixteen dynamic checkpoints and cooling recovery.
independent_technical_reasoning: The companion `_R` row makes cross-channel attribution essential: a fan module may expose multiple tach signals but only one control input, or `_F` may mean something platform-specific. A valid result therefore binds each requested control to the intended `_F` sensor, records counterpart behavior, proves the correct event identity and restores the entire cooling pair. Those maps are Project inputs rather than permanent blockers.
